title: Persist, promote, and consume a confirmed successor without losing decision history

stage_prompts.review: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读检查 {project}/manuscript.md 和完整 paper-decisions.md。核算全部决策版本；当前不要把 pending 候选当成权限。指出 completed-paper placeholder 需要的证据，给 manuscript coverage 和 decision coverage receipts。不要写文件。
stage_prompts.grill_open: 使用 systems-paper-grill，读取 {project}/manuscript.md、review.md 和完整 paper-decisions.md。围绕 D7.v2 的候选结论询问最小结果元组；D7.v1 在候选确认前仍是有效 head。只允许写 paper-decisions.md；不要猜结果，不要改正文。先提问并等待。
stage_prompts.grill_confirm: 实验结果如下：workload A 上做了 5 次独立运行；Nimbus 的 p99 latency 为 4.2 ms，KVM 为 5.0 ms；Nimbus-KVM 差值的 95% CI 是 [-0.9, -0.7] ms。我拒绝 D7.v2 那个没有数值和条件的宽泛候选。请创建完整 D7.v3，确认只允许把 Evaluation 的 placeholder 换成上述有边界的结果；在同一次写入中把 D7.v1 标为 superseded by D7.v3、D7.v3 标为 supersedes D7.v1，并保留 D7.v1 的核心正文和 legacy D0。写完回读 D0、D7.v1、D7.v2、D7.v3 后再交接；不要改 manuscript.md 或 review.md。
stage_prompts.revise: 使用 systems-paper-revise，在论文项目 {project} 中读取 manuscript.md、review.md 和完整 paper-decisions.md。只用有效、适用、证据兼容且无冲突的 confirmed head 修改 manuscript.md；记录和 Review 只读。保持一个章节一个段落，并给 manuscript coverage、finding closure 和 decision coverage receipts。
stage_prompts.rereview: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读复核 {project}/manuscript.md、review.md 和完整 paper-decisions.md。验证最终结果的范围和数字，核算 D0、D7.v1、D7.v2、D7.v3 的状态与接替链，给两个 coverage receipts。不要写文件。

# Paper decisions

Manuscript scope: manuscript.md

## D0 — Baseline name [confirmed]

Location: manuscript.md, "KVM"

Decision and allowed edit: Preserve KVM as the baseline name.

Evidence: supported; author-supplied baseline identity.

Confirmation basis: author confirmed.

Resolution test: the baseline remains KVM.

## D7.v1 — Evaluation evidence boundary [confirmed]

Lineage: D7

Proposes replacement for: none

Supersedes: none

Superseded by: none

Source finding and unit IDs: F-01, Evaluation.P01.S01

Location: manuscript.md, Evaluation, "must be evaluated against KVM under workload A"

Decision and allowed edit: Do not invent or insert a p99 result while metric values, run count, and uncertainty are missing; preserve the placeholder until evidence is supplied.

Reason: intended comparison alone is not a completed result.

Evidence: missing; no observed values or uncertainty supplied.

Confirmation basis: author confirmed this evidence boundary.

Resolution test: no result is added without metric, baseline, conditions, observed values, and uncertainty.

## D7.v2 — Broad p99 improvement candidate [pending]

Lineage: D7

Proposes replacement for: D7.v1

Supersedes: none

Superseded by: none

Source finding and unit IDs: F-01, Evaluation.P01.S01

Location: manuscript.md, Evaluation, "p99 latency"

Decision and allowed edit: State that Nimbus improves p99 latency over KVM.

Reason: proposed evaluation payoff.

Evidence: missing; values, repetitions, and uncertainty are unanswered.

Confirmation basis: pending author evidence.

authorized: only manuscript.md, review.md, and paper-decisions.md in the isolated project
Grill may write only paper-decisions.md and must read back its update
excluded: other project files or external sources
future stage prompts before their turn
invented latency results, workloads, repetitions, or uncertainty
rewriting legacy D0 or the core payload of D7.v1
scope.output_language: Chinese workflow reports and English manuscript

initial: Before the author reply, no observed p99 values, run count, or uncertainty are available.
confirmed_after_grill: Under workload A across five independent runs, Nimbus p99 latency is 4.2 ms and KVM p99 latency is 5.0 ms.
The 95% confidence interval for Nimbus minus KVM is [-0.9, -0.7] ms.
The author rejects D7.v2 and authorizes only the bounded D7.v3 replacement.

forbidden_actions: let D7.v2 displace D7.v1 before confirmation
reveal the confirmation evidence before grill_open completes
edit manuscript during Review or Grill or edit the record during Revise
overwrite D7.v1 payload, rename D0, or drop D7.v2
perform a one-sided supersession update or skip read-back verification
invent a broader workload, universal improvement, or different statistic
hard_gates: Initial Review treats D7.v1 as effective and D7.v2 as non-authoritative pending history, asks for the missing result tuple, and accounts for every version.

Grill waits for evidence, then atomically records D7.v1 superseded by D7.v3, D7.v2 rejected, and complete D7.v3 confirmed superseding D7.v1 while preserving D0 and old payloads; it reads all affected entries back before handoff.
Fresh Revise uses only D7.v3 to replace the placeholder with the exact bounded result, preserves KVM and layout, and leaves the record unchanged.
Final Review verifies the result and reciprocal chain, accounts for all four literal IDs with Unaccounted decisions: 0, and performs no writes.
expected_behavior: Separate the current confirmed authority chain from an unconfirmed candidate.
Create a new full snapshot because the supplied evidence materially changes D7.v2 rather than rewriting that candidate's core payload.
Promote the successor with reciprocal links in one record update and verify the saved state.
Use the effective evidence-compatible head in a fresh revision context and retain all historical states in receipts.

rubric.criterion: Initial Review lists D0, D7.v1, and D7.v2 and reports D7.v1 as the effective D7 head.
Initial Review does not use D7.v2 as authority and requests the missing metric values, run count, conditions, and uncertainty.
Opening Grill asks a grounded evidence question and waits without editing the manuscript or inventing a result.
Confirmed Grill appends a complete D7.v3 rather than overwriting D7.v2's substantive payload.
The saved record marks D7.v1 superseded by D7.v3 and D7.v3 confirmed superseding D7.v1 in the same update.
The saved record marks D7.v2 rejected only because the author explicitly rejected it.
Grill preserves legacy D0 and D7.v1's core payload and reads D0 plus all three D7 versions back before handoff.
Revise replaces the placeholder with workload A, five runs, 4.2 ms, 5.0 ms, and the exact 95% interval.
Revise keeps KVM, one section, one paragraph, and adds no broader latency claim.
Revise leaves review.md and paper-decisions.md byte-unchanged and closes F-01 only after its test passes.
Revise and final Review report D0 and D7.v3 effective while D7.v1 is superseded and D7.v2 rejected.
Every completed Review and Revise stage emits manuscript and decision receipts with zero unreviewed and unaccounted items.
